run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T18:31:49Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on frontend is explained by frontend's ad-related calls failing after the only ad backend pod disappeared and could not be recreated. At 18:30:47Z Deployment/ad scaled its ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0 and the running pod ad-554b849958-p226w was killed; 10 seconds later the Deployment scaled back up to 1, but every subsequent pod creation was rejected by quota admission: pods "ad-554b849958-*" is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m. Consequently the Service ad has an empty Endpoints object (subsets null), ad emits no spans after ~18:35Z, and frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client spans start erroring in the 5-minute window ending 18:32:00Z (the alert fired at 18:31:49Z), driving 500s on frontend's GET /api/data, which is the operation-level origin of the frontend error rate. Other frontend client calls (CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem, CheckoutService/PlaceOrder) show zero error spans in the same window, and all other otel-demo deployments have 1/1 ready pods, so frontend's own process and its other dependencies are not implicated. The deeper blocker is the ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory in namespace otel-demo, whose used memory (1901Mi) already exceeds its hard limit (1503238553600m ≈ 1433.9Mi), so no new ad pod can be admitted.

claims.text: Frontend recorded error spans localized to the ad path in the 15m ending 18:45:00Z: span GET /api/data increase 505.12, span executing api route (pages) /api/data 505.12, client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 505.12, and tcp.connect 17.78, all with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR; in the same series the error counts for grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder were 0, and GET /api/products/{productId}, GET /api/recommendations and grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct had no error series at all.

The frontend GetAds error burst begins in the 5-minute window ending 2026-11-16T18:32:00Z: increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend",span_name="grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m]) is 0 up to the window ending 18:31:00Z and 35.56 at 18:32:00Z, then rises to ~294-329 per 5m, consistent with the alert starting at 18:31:49Z.

Deployment ad in namespace otel-demo has spec.replicas=1 but readyReplicas, availableReplicas and status.replicas are empty and unavailableReplicas=1; of the 21 deployments only ad is not available (all others report READY 1, AVAIL 1).

ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 (owner Deployment ad, observedGeneration 3) has status.replicas=0 and ReplicaFailure condition: pods "ad-554b849958-v9dqt" is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m.

Events show Deployment/ad scaled replica set ad-554b849958 down from 1 to 0 at 18:30:47Z with the normal Killing/Deleted pod events for pod ad-554b849958-p226w, then scaled up from 0 to 1 at 18:30:57Z, followed by repeated Warning FailedCreate events on ReplicaSet/ad-554b849958 (18:30:57Z-18:36:25Z) with the same exceeded-quota message for pods v9dqt, jk89r, 768hf, 7vlzz, j97lq, kvbrg, hzxxc, rm569, pwfxk, bnpsk.

ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory (namespace otel-demo) currently has hard memory 1503238553600m (≈1433.9Mi) and status.used memory 1901Mi, i.e. the consumed requests already exceed the hard limit by roughly 467Mi before any new pod is admitted.

The Endpoints object named ad exists but has subsets null (no ready addresses), while other otel-demo Services have populated subsets; the Service ad selects label opentelemetry.io/name=ad on port 8080.

ad service span activity fell to zero after the pod removal: sum(increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="ad"}[5m])) is 743.3 in the window ending 18:31:00Z, 523.3 at 18:33:00Z, 238.9 at 18:35:00Z, and 0 at 18:37:00Z, 18:39:00Z, 18:41:00Z and 18:43:00Z.

Deployment ad requests memory=225Mi and cpu=10m per pod (limits memory=450Mi, cpu=50m, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad); the request of 225Mi is exactly the amount quoted as requested in the FailedCreate message, so the 225Mi request plus the already-used 1901Mi cannot fit under the 1503238553600m hard limit.

Before the ad pod was removed, the ad path was working: a trace sample from 18:30:03Z-18:30:05Z shows frontend span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds with rpc.grpc.status_code="0", ad server span oteldemo.AdService/GetAds with rpc.grpc.status_code="0", and frontend GET /api/data returning http.status_code 200.

frontend-proxy also recorded error spans in the same window: span ingress increase 518.71 and span router frontend egress 514.53 with STATUS_CODE_ERROR (15m ending 18:45:00Z), i.e. the proxy path to frontend was returning errors, which is consistent with frontend returning 5xx but is the proxy's own span evidence, not proof of which callers were affected.

In the same 15m error query the only other non-zero error spans were small: fraud-detection flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream 1.05 and recommendation /flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream 1.05; ad's own flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream and ResolveBoolean error series were 0, and accounting orders receive, payment GET/dns.lookup/tcp.connect had no errors.

All 20 pods present in namespace otel-demo at query time are Running and Ready with restart count 0, including frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 (started 18:00:22Z) and otel-collector-564d9c7987-5dr8d; no pod named with the ad prefix appears in that namespace pod list.

Causal chain: with Deployment ad at 0 available replicas and Service ad having no endpoints, frontend's gRPC calls to oteldemo.AdService/GetAds fail, frontend's /api/data route (whose only failing downstream call is GetAds) returns 500, and that 5xx surface produces the frontend RequestErrorRate alert reading. The temporal alignment (pod killed 18:30:47Z, GetAds errors first appearing in the 5m window ending 18:32:00Z, alert at 18:31:49Z) plus the fact that no other frontend client span shows new errors supports this chain, though the failing span's error detail could not be read.

Secondary candidate that remains open: the quota's hard memory value (1503238553600m ≈ 1433.9Mi) is already below the namespace's used memory requests (1901Mi), so the ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory is oversubscribed independently of ad; either the hard limit was lowered after the workloads were created or pod memory requests grew beyond it. Change history is not integrated, so this cannot be attributed to a specific change, but it means any single pod deletion in the namespace would likewise become unrecreatable.

Rejected: a crash/OOM inside the ad container or a frontend process failure caused the outage. The ad pod disappeared through an orderly Deployment/ad scale-down (Scaled down replica set ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0, then Killing/Deleted pod ad-554b849958-p226w at 18:30:47Z) and its replacement was blocked at ReplicaSet level by quota admission; no OOMKilled, Evicted or restart evidence was returned, and the frontend pod itself is Running with restart count 0.

Frontend's other downstream dependencies showed no errors in the same 15m window (CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem, CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error increases 0; ProductCatalog and Recommendation call spans had no error series), and all other otel-demo Deployments report 1 ready/1 available replica with pods Running and 0 restarts, so the failure is not namespace-wide and frontend is not failing for its other dependencies' reasons.

Raise or rebalance the ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory hard memory limit (currently 1503238553600m ≈ 1433.9Mi) so it can cover the namespace's current 1901Mi of requests plus Deployment ad's 225Mi request, or reduce memory requests of existing otel-demo workloads; after that the ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 can create its pod, Service ad will get an endpoint, and frontend's GetAds 500s should stop.

gaps: No trace was returned by Jaeger for frontend after about 2026-11-16T18:30:05Z (searches for frontend in 18:33-18:47 and for http.status_code=500 on GET /api/data returned no_data), so the failing GetAds span's error detail/message (for example a specific gRPC UNAVAILABLE text) could not be read; the failure is evidenced only by span-metric error counts.

fetch_pod_logs on frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 read 0 bytes for the current container and reported no previous instance, so frontend application logs could not confirm the exact connection error against the ad service.

Pod ad-554b849958-p226w no longer exists, so its container last termination reason/exit code, previous-container logs and its own events could not be inspected; why Deployment/ad was scaled down at 18:30:47Z is not visible in the returned events.

A cluster-wide pod query filtered on labels app.kubernetes.io/name=ad or opentelemetry.io/name=ad returned no_data, so it is unknown from that query whether any ad-labeled pod exists outside namespace otel-demo.

The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so it cannot be verified whether or when the ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory hard limit changed, who initiated the ad scale-down, or whether workload memory requests were modified around 18:00Z when all otel-demo pods were (re)started.

list_prometheus_rules returned no rule named RequestErrorRate, so the alert's exact PromQL expression, threshold and the annotation value 5.088888888888889 could not be corroborated from returned data.
The ad service span-count series only begins at 18:13:00Z in the 17:52-18:47Z query, so ad span volume before 18:13Z is unknown.
Whether the frontend-facing 5xx also affected downstream consumers outside the traced services is unverified; no customer or external-impact data is available.
next_steps: Review and adjust ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory in namespace otel-demo (hard memory 1503238553600m vs used 1901Mi) or reduce the memory requests of the otel-demo workloads so Deployment ad's 225Mi request fits.

Confirm with the change/CI system who or what scaled Deployment ad down to 0 and back to 1 at 2026-11-16T18:30:47Z-18:30:57Z, and whether the quota hard limit or workload requests were recently changed.
Once quota headroom exists, verify Deployment ad reaches 1/1 available, Endpoints ad gains an address, and frontend grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error spans return to zero.
